data.title: Add state caching for performance
data.body:
## Goal

Cache derived bug state to avoid re-reading and replaying all events on every command.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Create `.docket/cache/` directory
- [ ] Cache derived bug state in `.docket/cache/bugs.json` or similar
- [ ] Invalidate cache when any `.jsonl` file is newer than cache
- [ ] `docket list` uses cache when valid
- [ ] `docket show` uses cache when valid
- [ ] Commands that modify bugs update the cache
- [ ] `docket cache clear` command to manually invalidate
- [ ] Cache is optional - commands work without it (just slower)

## Context

Every `docket list` currently reads every `.jsonl` file and replays all events. For a project with hundreds of bugs, this becomes noticeable.

Since events are append-only, caching is safe: we just need to check if any event file is newer than the cache timestamp.

Consider: per-bug cache files vs single aggregate cache file.
